get_supported_providers: get a sorted list of all llm providers supported by litellm
get_supported_endpoints: get the list of litellm proxy endpoints and which providers support each one
get_litellm_model_cost_map: get pricing information for all supported litellm models
get_litellm_blog_posts: get the latest litellm blog posts from github with a 1-hour cache
get_agent_fields: get agent type metadata required by the dashboard create-agent flow
get_provider_fields: get provider metadata required by the dashboard create-model flow
get_agents: get the list of public agents from the global agent registry
get_mcp_servers: get the list of public mcp servers from the global mcp server manager
public_model_hub: get the list of model groups with health check status from the model hub
public_model_hub_info: get litellm proxy info including docs title, version, and useful links
public_skill_hub: get enabled public claude code skills from the database
build_endpoints: build the supported endpoints response from raw provider endpoint support data
clean_display_name: clean a raw display name by removing slug suffix patterns
